name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a services agreement covering the provider's AI features: how customer Input and AI-generated Output are handled, restrictions on training models with customer data, and related responsibilities.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose and safeguard Protected Health Information (PHI), including breach reporting and subcontractor obligations.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, customer obligations, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability limits, indemnification and term.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Data protection terms for a provider processing personal data on a customer's behalf, covering processor and subprocessor relationships, security, data subject requests and international transfers (EEA SCCs and UK Addendum).

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement giving an early-stage partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback, covering product access, feedback rights, confidentiality and intellectual property.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA under which both parties can share confidential information for a stated purpose, covering use restrictions, exceptions, term and return of information.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, term, governing law and other key terms, and sign. It incorporates the Mutual NDA standard terms by reference.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement for business partnerships such as referral, reseller or co-marketing arrangements, covering each party's obligations, trademark use, payments, confidentiality and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Agreement for a limited-time trial or proof of concept, letting a customer evaluate a product during a pilot period before committing to a full purchase.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for professional services delivered under Statements of Work (SOWs), covering performance of services, deliverables, fees, intellectual property, warranties and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms for a cloud service, defining target uptime and support response commitments and the service credits a customer receives when they are missed.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or downloadable software, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, liability limits and term.
